name: Tessera AutoCab
description: A small autonomous electric car that serves as GLMZ's taxi service for Tier 2-4 residents. Clean, climate-controlled, surveillance-equipped. Every ride is recorded, analyzed, and sold to data brokers. The AutoCab knows where you went, when, and with whom. It's comfortable, convenient, and a privacy nightmare. Tier 1 residents can't afford it. Tier 5 wouldn't be caught dead in one.
cost: Φ10-50 per ride depending on distance and demand surge
autonomy: Fully autonomous. Tessera AI routing and dispatch.
armament: Interior locking system, silent alarm, passenger restraint capability (classified).
common_usage: Mid-tier commuters, business travel, anyone who needs point-to-point transport and doesn't mind being watched.
story_hooks: An AutoCab's AI refuses to take a passenger to a specific address and won't explain why
Someone discovers the AutoCab surveillance data is being used to build predictive models of citizen behavior — and the predictions are getting uncomfortably accurate
